title: "After the day"
aliases:
  - /tracks/one-day-replication/after.html
---
A day on open research stops before the robustness exercise of the course, in which you would vary the analysis yourself, one decision at a time, send your results to a class chart, and run the specification that you preregistered. The [one-day course on methods](../eu-frames-one-day-methods/index.qmd) does that on the same case, and the [exercise overview](../../cases/eu-frames/exercise.qmd) sets out Tasks 4 and 5 in full. Both tasks run in the [browser lab](../../cases/eu-frames/lab.qmd#task-4-explore) and in the downloadable workspace, which you can install by following the [setup page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html) of the AR4DS site. The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) covers the material that the day could only mention in passing, in modules that each stand on their own.

- [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd) shows where data, code and registrations are deposited, how a record keeps its versions, and the two preregistration templates.
- [Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html), on the AR4DS site, shows how to version a project of your own and publish its report.
- [Social science data sources](../../companion/data-sources.qmd) maps where the data for a project of your own may be held, and follows the routes by which the data behind this case were obtained.
- [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) and [Reading a specification curve](../../cases/eu-frames/reading-inference.qmd) take the second R further, to what happens to the result when the choices of an analysis change.
- [Causal graphs and adjustment sets](../../companion/dags.qmd) works through the causal graph that Part 2 left optional.
- [Building the analysis file](../../companion/data-management.qmd) shows how the panel was built from the survey files.
- [R on the country-year panel](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) takes R further on the panel of the case, and [Quarto documents](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html), on the AR4DS site, explains the document format of the workspace.
- [The case study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd) and the [resources page](../../resources.qmd) tell the whole story of the case, with the sources.

The [AR4DS site](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/) describes the four cases of the course and holds its setup and help pages. The [one-day course on data tools](../eu-frames-one-day-data-tools/index.qmd) takes the same case through R, data management and reports, and the [three-day course](../eu-frames-three-days/index.qmd) builds the data from the raw survey files.
